revenue_base.method: Average revenue of the last 3 months, rolled forward to the last month at revenue_growth

revenue_growth.method: Log-linear trend fit over the last 12 months of revenue

gross_margin.method: (revenue - cogs) / revenue over the last 6 months

opex_base.method: Average opex of the last 3 months, rolled forward to the last month at opex_growth

opex_growth.method: Log-linear trend fit over the last 12 months of opex

other_net.method: Average net other income of the last 6 months

tax_rate.method: No tax rows; set tax_rate to model income tax

dso_days.method: receivables / monthly revenue x 30.4 days, last 3 months with balances

dio_days.method: No inventory in the balance sheet

dpo_days.method: payables / monthly cash costs (cogs + opex - depreciation) x 30.4 days, last 3 months with balances

capex_monthly.method: Change in fixed assets + depreciation, last 3 months with consecutive balances

depreciation_monthly.method: No depreciation in the income statement; tag depreciation accounts 'depreciation' to model it

useful_life_months.method: Default 60 months (5 years) for capex above the baseline; override per scenario or per purchase

interest_rate.method: No interest rows; set interest_rate to charge interest on debt

formulas.interest: interest[t] = debt[t-1] * interest_rate / 12 (recent average if there's no balance sheet)
formulas.tax: tax[t] = tax_rate * max(0, pretax_income[t] - losses carried forward)
formulas.depreciation: depreciation[t] = depreciation_monthly + extra capex / useful_life_months, from the month after purchase
formulas.tax_payable: tax accrues monthly and is paid the month after each quarter end
formulas.operating_cash_flow: net_income + depreciation - change in receivables - change in inventory + change in payables
formulas.cash: cash[t] = cash[t-1] + operating - capex + debt and equity raised

opex.label: Driver model: trend growth x seasonal index
opex.reason: Lowest backtest error over 3 origins x 6 months (WAPE 1.9%); simpler models win near-ties

uncertainty.method: Each path multiplies the point forecast by noise fitted to history: a starting-level error, a growth-rate error that compounds, and month-to-month AR(1) noise. Gross margin and other income vary around their fitted values. Lines are simulated independently. Ranges are widened, never narrowed, when the backtest shows they caught fewer than 80% of actual months.
